user.title: Add an imhd.sk stop
user.description: Realtime departures from imhd.sk (unofficial integration). Each configured stop keeps one connection to imhd.sk.

data_description.city: The imhd.sk city / region the stop belongs to.

reconfigure.title: Change the stop
reconfigure.description: Pick a new stop for this entry. The name and the other filters are kept; the platform filter is cleared, because platforms belong to a stop.

location.title: Pick a location
location.description: Stops nearest to this point will be offered.

data_description.query: Part of the stop name, for example {example}

data_description.stop: A numeric stop ID or the address of an imhd.sk online departure board, for example {example_url}

data_description.name: Used for the device and the entity ids, e.g. `sensor.hodzovo_departures` for the name Hodzovo.
data_description.platforms: Only show departures from these platforms. Leave empty for all platforms.
data_description.lines: Only show these lines (exact match, case-insensitive). Leave empty for all lines.
data_description.direction: Only show departures whose destination or terminal stop contains one of these texts (case and diacritics are ignored).
data_description.max_departures: How many departures the main sensor lists (1-30).
data_description.walking_time: Minutes you need to reach the stop. Departures you cannot catch any more are hidden.
data_description.time_to_leave_window: The Time to leave sensor turns on this many minutes before you have to leave.

get_departures.description: Returns the upcoming departures of a configured stop.

entity_id.description: Any entity of the stop, e.g. its Departures sensor.

config_entry_id.name: Stop
config_entry_id.description: The stop (config entry), used when no entity is given.

direction.name: Direction
direction.description: Only departures whose destination or terminal stop contains this text.

limit.description: Maximum number of departures (default: the stop's maximum departures).

min_minutes.name: Minimum minutes
min_minutes.description: Skip departures leaving sooner than this.

find_stops.name: Find stops
find_stops.description: Finds imhd.sk stops near a location (default: home) or by name.

city.description: imhd.sk city / section code or city name.

latitude.name: Latitude
latitude.description: Latitude of the search point (default: home).

longitude.description: Longitude of the search point (default: home).

subscription_rejected.title: imhd.sk refused the connection for {name}
subscription_rejected.description: imhd.sk refused the realtime connection for stop {stop_id} ({reason}). This usually means too many connections, for example too many configured stops or other imhd.sk boards open from the same IP address. The integration retries every 15 to 60 minutes; call the `imhd.refresh` action to retry now.

yaml_entry_removed.title: Stop {name} was removed from YAML
yaml_entry_removed.description: The stop {name} was imported from YAML but is no longer in the `imhd:` configuration. Delete the entry in Settings > Devices & services if you do not need it any more.
